de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba dang om̐ dang bcas pa rnams gtor ma la thim pas/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams la | om̐.āḥhūm̐ dang*/ ha ho hrīḥs byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor dmigs la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod brgyad kyang yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad du gyur pa/ ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas pa'i lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba'i lam nas gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī sa mā ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ om̐ ā:hūm̐/ zhes lha'am 'khor lo'i grangs dang mnyam pa dang*/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i phreng sngags kyis phul nas phyi nang yid las byung bas mchod la/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod de/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol nas

| badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o | | 'jig rten pa la ni mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor mas dbul lo/ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang he ru kar dmigs pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me 'bar bas lus yongs su gang ba'i khrod na/ snying gar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ nang gi gtso bo'i rigs bdag tu bla ma bzhugs shing*/ lto bar dur khrod ¡Ã na gnas pa'i lha ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ¡¶ lu ¡· pa ) rnams dang*/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad gnas par bsams la/ lag pa'i mchod pas lag pa'i lha mchod nas/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs/ kha hom khung*/ kha zas bsreg rdzas su dmigs te shin tu zhen par mi bya zhing ro phyin par zos nas/ lhag ma om̐ u ts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin no/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// // de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa la goms pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin spros bcas dang*/ spros med dang*/ shin tu spros med kyis brtan par byas pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes skyes pa dang*/ gzhan gyi don du kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa spyad pas byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu gnyis bgrod de nye ba'i rgyus mtshams sbyar nas/ rang dang gzhan gyi don lhun gyis grub pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni zhar las 'byung ba nyid do/ /'di yang rang gi slob ma mchog | ji big de mur gyis bskul nas/ /'phags pas sbyar ba'i dge ba yis | | 'gro kun he ru kar gyur cig /slob dpon lū hi pa'i rjes su 'brang pa'i dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni/ 'phags pas lcags mo lug gi lo/ smin drug zla ba'i tshes nyi shu lnga'i nyin par shing kun gyi mkhar du nyung zhing gsal ba'i tshig gis rnam par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o//

// ༄༅/ /bde mchog gi rgyun bshags ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + tshogs bsags bcu gsum tshigs bcad ma ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bhaṭ+ṭā ra kā ya/ na maḥshrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes sku/ /thugs rje chen pos thabs tshul sna tshogs kyis/ /gdul bya kun mkhyen sa la 'god mdzad pa/ /bla med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin ye shes chen po'i sku | | sprul pa'i 'od 'phro shes rab phag mos 'khyud/ /byang chub phyogs chos dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs/ /srid zhi'i dbang phyug kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nye bar bkod dang bdag pos ma bzung dang*/ /gsang ba'i rdzas dang zag med bde chen dang*/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po ni/ /nam mkha' dag dang mnyam pas rtag tu mchod/ /thog med dus nas nyon mongs dbang gyur pas | | lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa ci bgyis dang*/ /bgyid du stsal dang de la yi rang ba'i/ /nyes pa'i tshogs rnams mgon po'i spyan sngar bshags/ /deng nas byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid bla ma dam pa dang | | yon tan mtha' yas rgyal dang dam pa'i chos/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bdag skyabs mchi/ /gsang ba bla med 'khor lo sdom pa yi// thun mong ba dang khyad par dam tshig kun/ /bdag gis yongs su bzung zhing byang chub bar/ /lus ngag yid kyis 'bad de bskyang bar bgyi/ /dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom dang*/ /so so'i skye bo'i dge ba ci mchis pa/ /ma lus pa la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /phyogs bcu'i bder gshegs sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /'gro ba'i don du byang chub thugs bskyed ltar/ /bdag gis kyang ni byang chub sems bskyed cing*/ /byang chub spyod pa bla med spyad par bgyi/ /ma lus phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs gyur pa'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyi drung du bdag mchis te/

/mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /bla med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'gro kun kun mkhyen go 'phang la gnas par/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs nas gdul bya yi/ /don kun mdzad par bdag gis gsol ba 'debs/ / bdag gis sems can kun gyi don slad du/ /he ru ka dpal go 'phang bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /zab mo 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam gyi mchog /rim pa gnyis la yang dag gnas par bgyi/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mchog /dri med rab tu dkar ba gang yod des/ /sku gsum bdag nyid he ru kar gyur nas/ / 'khor 'das ma lus yongs su 'dren par shog /rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod kyis legs bsgrubs pa'i/ /gnas pa 'di ni legs par gnas pa ste/ /lam mchog 'di yis ring por mi thogs par/ /rang gzhan don rdzogs he ru kar 'gyur ro/ /bla ma mchog dang kun bzang he ru ka'i/ /bka' drin chen pos bdag kyang legs bskyangs nas/ /dngos grub chen pos bdag yid tshim mdzod la/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas slar yang byon/ /tshul 'di ni ma'i ma gsang ba bla na med pa 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas | rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + chen po ) lū hi pa'i dgongs pa/ dpal nā ro pa las brgyud de 'ongs pa'o/ /tshigs su bcad par gang gis bsdebs she na/ dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rje mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len zhing*/ de nyid kyi rjes su bzung ba'i dge tshul rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas/ chu pho ¡Ã bya yi ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· byi ba'i ) lo rta pa'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad la byang ngos ling chu tser khab tu sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /dkyil 'khor la bstod pa'i rab byed bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba/

bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis dpal las byung gyur zhing*/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med bdag / bde chen gsang ba mi zad pa/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/ /'khor los sgyur mdzad srid zhi'i dpal/ /bde mchog rdo rje phag mo yis/ /kun nas 'khyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi dbyings las byung gyur zhing*/ /bud med sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /ye shes sgyu ma kun skyed pa/ /rdo rje phag mor phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i shar gnas shing | | byams pa chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /byin gyis rlob pa'i las mdzad pa/ / mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po'i g.yon zhal mdun gnas shing | | btang snyoms chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /phrin las rjes su sgrub mdzad pa// lā mā la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gyi rgyab zhal mdun gnas shing*/ /dga' ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor mdzad pa/ /dum skyes ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtso bo'i g.yas zhal mdun gnas shing*/ /snying rje chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /dbang bskur ba yi las mdzad pa/ /gzugs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun kyang yon tan ngo bo ste/ /ser sna la sogs skyon sbyong zhing */ / dkyil 'khor ¡Ã snying por ( ¡¶ zha ¡· chen por ) rnam rol pa/ /bde chen 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar rtsibs pul+līr mi phyed dang*/ /so dang sen mo'i khams sbyong ba/ /thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum mo/ /mnyam par sbyor la phyag 'tshal lo | | byang phyogs dzā lan+dha ra ru/ /phra gzugs skra ( ¡¶ lu ¡· ma ) dang spu sbyong ba/ / keng rus chen po gtum mig ma/ /snyoms 'jug mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nub phyogs o ḍ+yan rtse ma ni/ /pags pa dri ma'i khams sbyong ba/ /kaṃ kā la dang 'od ldan ma/ /kun tu sbyor ba phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs a rbur g.yon ma dang | | sha yi khams ni yongs sbyong ba/ /mche ba rnam gtsigs sna chen ma/ / yang dag sbyor la phyag 'tshal lo/

/shar lho go dā wa rī ru/ /thung ngu rtsa rgyus khams sbyong ba/ /su ra bai ri brtan blo ma/ /gnyis med bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub rā mer rus sbal skyes/ /rus pa dri ma'i khams sbyong ba// 'od dpag med dang kharba ri/ /kun nas sbyor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang de wī ko ṭar ni/ /skom dang mchin pa'i khams sbyong ba/ /rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang | | snyoms par zhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar mā lar dbang ma dang | | snying gi khams ni yongs sbyong ba/ /rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma/ kha sbyor mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun kyang thugs kyi ngo bo ste/ /sems dang zhe sdang rnam par sbyong*/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /thugs kyi 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar phyogs kām rūr skyon ma dang*/ /mig gi khams ni yongs sbyong ba/ /myu gu can dang sa srungs ma/ /rnam par rol la phyag 'tshal lo | | byang phyogs o ṭer mjug ma dang*/ /mkhris pa'i khams ni rnam sbyong ba | | rdo rje ral pa 'jigs byed ma/ /dga' mgur spyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nub phyogs tri sha ku ne ru/ /ma mo glo ba'i khams sbyong ba/ /dpa' bo chen po ¡Ã rlung shugs ( ¡¶ zha ¡· shugs can ) mas/ /nye bar 'khril la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs rtsibs kyi ko sa lar/ /mtshan ma rgyu ma'i khams sbyong ba/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad chang 'thungs ma/ /bde bas myos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar lho'i rtsibs kyi ka liṅgar/ /bsil sbyin rgyus pa'i khams sbyong ba/ /rab tu bzang dang ljang lha mo/ /rtse zhing rol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub lam pār tsha ba dang*/ /lto ba'i khams ni yongs sbyong ba/ /rdo rje bzang pa ོ bzang mo yis/ /rnam par mchod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang kāñtsir gzhol ma dang*/ /bshang ba'i khams ni sbyong mdzad pa/ /'jigs byed che dang rta rna ma/ /bde bas dgyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar hi mā la ya ru/ /rangs ma rgyus pa'i dwangs ma sbyong*/

/ mig mi bzang dang kha gā na/ /rnam par rtsen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun kyang gsung gi ngo bo ste/ /ngag dang 'dod chags rnam par sbyong*/ /sa la spyod pa'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /gsung gi 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar rtsibs pre tar gzugs can dang*/ /bad kan khams ni rnam sbyong ba/ /stobs chen 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ /gnyis med rol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang rtsibs gṛ har spyi ma dang*/ /rnag gi khams ni yongs sbyong ba/ /rin chen rdo rje dum skyes mas | | kun nas mchod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub kyi rtsibs kyi sau rāṣ+tar/ /rgyu sbyin ma dang khrag sbyong ma/ /rta mgrin dang ni shauṇ+ḍi nī/ /kun du rol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs su war+ṇa dwī par/ /sbyor bral rdul gyi khams sbyong ba/ / mkha' snying 'khor lo'i go cha mas/ /nye bar bsten la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar lho mtshams kyi na ga rar/ /sdu gu ma dang tshil sbyong ba/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' mo dang*/ /zung du 'jug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub sin+dhur grub ma dang*/ / mchi ma'i khams ni yongs sbyong ba/ /pad+ma gar dbang stobs chen mas/ /yongs su mchod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang ma ror 'tshed ma dang*/ /mchil ma'i khams ni rab sbyong ba/ /rnam snang 'khor los sgyur ma yis/ /bde bas dgyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar rtsibs kyi ku lu tār/ /yid bzang ma dang snabs sbyong ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' brtson chen mas/ /rnam par mchod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun kyang sku yi ngo bo ste/ /lus dang gti mug rnam par sbyong*/ /sa 'og spyod pa'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /sku yi 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 'khor shar gyi sgor gnas shing*/ /zhi dang dgug pa'i las mdzad pa/ /bya rog gdong can bya rog ltar/ /brkam gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 'khor byang gi sgaur gnas shing*/ /'bebs dang drag po'i las mdzad ma/ /'ug pa'i gdong can 'ug pa ltar/ /rnam bsgyings ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 'khor nub kyi sgor gnas shing*/

/bcing dang dbang gi las mdzad pa/ khyi yi gdong can nor srung ltar/ /g.yel med ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 'khor lho yi sgor gnas shing*/ /gzhug dang rgyas pa'i las mdzad pa/ /phag gi gdong can phag bzhin du/ /rtog med ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar lho'i grwar ni legs bzhugs nas/ /brtan pa'i dug dang dbul sel zhing*/ /rgyal ba ma lus mnyes byed ma/ /gshin rje'i brtan mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub grwar ni legs bzhugs nas/ /'chi bdag nyes spyod kun sel zhing*/ /dkyil 'khor pa kun mdzes byed ma/ /gshin rje'i pho nyar phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang grwar ni legs bzhugs nas/ /g.yo ba'i dug dang khro 'joms shing*/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi dbyangs ldan ma/ /gshin rje mche ba mar phyag 'tshal/ /byang shar grwar ni legs bzhugs nas/ /bgegs dang g.yel ba rnams sel zhing*// zhal dang phyag zhabs kun bskyod ma/ /gshin rje 'joms mar phyag 'tshal lo// kun kyang phrin las ngo bo ste/ /las ngan phrag dog rnam par sbyong*/ /kun tu spyod pa'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /dam tshig 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes ¡Ã rin chen ( ¡¶ zha ¡· rang bzhin ) las grub cing*/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par mdzes | | lus dang zhing kun yongs sbyong ba/ /gzhal yas khang la phyag 'tshal lo | | phyi rol 'khor yug legs gnas nas/ /dkyil 'khor pa kun mchod byed cing*/ /sgrub pa po la mchog stsol ba/ /dur khrod gnas pa rnams la 'dud | | stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i dngos/ /bdud dpung nges par 'joms byed cing*/ /mi phyed rnal 'byor pa yi dpal/ /srung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags dang ting nge 'dzin brtson zhing*/ /phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i | | mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod bgyid kyis/ /dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol | | bde mchog 'khor lor bstod bgyis pa'i/ /dge bas bdag gzhan bde kun la/ /'tshe med spyad nas bde ba'i mchog /bde chen he ru kar gyur cig

| dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni ston pa shes rab ces bya bas bskul nas/ dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pa zhes bya bas lcags mo lug gi lo/ nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyi shu bzhi'i nyi ma gung gi cha la cang to'i pho brang chen por shin tu myur du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra lags so// // ༄༅/ /sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi bstod bskul bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐ nga ni sku gsum mnyam sbyor zhing*/ /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid dngos/ khyab bdag srid dang zhi ba'i gtso | | he ru ka dpal rgyal po yi/ /de yi thugs kar gnas pa'i hūm̐/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa las grol zhing*/ /gnyis med ye shes chen po'i dngos/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi ldan pa/ /de las skyes pa'i khwa gdong ma/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi/ /pho nya bskal ba'i me ltar 'phro/ /nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas/ / gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun
